resources.string: Shows the circle/card float bar. The screen is captured only when you tap the circle button, so you can circle a question and send it to the AI.
Sends when you pause; keep drawing to extend the circle
Write something on the pad first
Too short: tap once to start talking, tap again when you\'re done.
Speech recognition failed; check the network and try again.
Didn\'t catch that, please say it again.
Microphone allowed. Go back to the answer card (tap the card button on the float bar) and tap 🎤 Ask to start talking.
Microphone access is needed to ask by voice.
No answers yet. Tap the circle button and circle a question first.
Circle a question, tap once, and get just the hint you need right now.

Turn on \"Quanwen float bar\" in the system accessibility settings. If the switch is greyed out, open App info, choose \"Allow restricted settings\" from the top-right menu, then come back and turn it on.
New session started; earlier questions will no longer be sent as context
No API key yet: enter your OpenAI key above, then tap Test connection.
Without the float bar: circle in the app

Works even where accessibility can\'t be turned on (for example HarmonyOS with Zhuoyitong). Split the screen: notes on one half, Quanwen on the other. Tap Screenshot on the circle page (never saved to the gallery; in split screen Quanwen crops out its own half), or take a system screenshot and Quanwen loads it automatically, then circle right here; you can also drag the screenshot thumbnail straight into Quanwen. Or pick an image from the gallery, paste one, or photograph paper notes.
Circle your question; pinch to zoom. New screenshots load automatically.
Load an image with the buttons above (latest screenshot, screenshot — temporary, never saved to the gallery — gallery or paste), or drag a screenshot here.
Photo access is needed to read the latest screenshot; you can also pick one from the gallery.
This is a new session. Circle a question to start; nothing from other sessions is carried over. Tap ☰ at the top right to switch back to another session.
Quanwen can take screenshots (used only on the circle page, never saved to the gallery; stops when you leave the page)
Screenshot failed: the system sent no picture (%1$s). Tap Screenshot again to allow it again; if it still fails, take a system screenshot and Quanwen loads it automatically.
Screenshot failed: the picture came back black (%1$s); this screen may block capture. Try a system screenshot instead.
Screen capture was stopped by the system. Tap Screenshot again to allow it.
This device needs a different capture method. Please allow screen capture once more.
No image on the clipboard. Copy a screenshot first, then tap Paste.
Couldn\'t get an image: this source doesn\'t support dropping here. Try Latest screenshot, Gallery or Paste.
Allow Quanwen to install apps on the page that opens, then come back and tap Download and install again.
Nothing yet. Tap the circle button on the float bar and circle a question.
